lines.zh: 我顺着浅溪的碎石往下游。
lines.en: I drift downstream over the shallow pebbles.

lines.zh: 森林的落叶盖住我半个身子。
lines.en: Forest leaves cover half of my small body.

lines.zh: 芦苇根间有条窄缝，我钻过去。
lines.en: A narrow gap between reed roots; I slip through.

lines.zh: 水流推我，我偏要贴着岸边。
lines.en: The current pushes me; I hug the bank instead.

lines.zh: 我在柳影里摆尾，慢慢往前。
lines.en: I flick my tail through willow shade, going slow.

lines.zh: 这片河湾安静，我绕着石头转。
lines.en: This bend is quiet, so I circle the stone.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙底滑，鳞片刮着沙。
lines.en: I slide along the sandy bottom, scales scraping.

lines.zh: 森林的水凉，我游得更轻快。
lines.en: Forest water runs cold, so I swim lighter.

lines.zh: 我逆流摆尾，只为回到那片浅滩。
lines.en: I beat upstream just to reach that shallow flat.

lines.zh: 六个变种里，我这身颜色最常见。
lines.en: Of six variants, my colour is the commonest.

lines.zh: 我绕过倒木，鳍尖扫过树皮。
lines.en: I round a fallen log, fin tips brushing bark.

lines.zh: 河底的石子被水磨得发亮。
lines.en: The river stones are worn bright by the water.

lines.zh: 我一摆尾，惊起一小团泥沙。
lines.en: One tail-flick stirs up a little cloud of silt.

lines.zh: 天光落在水面，我追着那道光。
lines.en: Sky light lands on the water; I chase it.

lines.zh: 我摆尾穿过一丛水草。
lines.en: I swish through a clump of weeds.

lines.zh: 浅滩的水温，刚合适。
lines.en: The shallows are just the right warmth.

lines.zh: 我悬在芦苇影里，一动也不动。
lines.en: I hang in the reed shadows without moving.

lines.zh: 水面上的云慢慢移过去。
lines.en: The clouds on the surface drift slowly past.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，什么也没咬到。
lines.en: I open my mouth and catch nothing at all.

lines.zh: 河水绕过我的鳍，很轻。
lines.en: The river slips past my fins, very gently.

lines.zh: 森林那头有鸟叫，我不理。
lines.en: Birds call from the forest; I ignore them.

lines.zh: 我把身子藏在石缝的暗处。
lines.en: I tuck my body into the dark stone gap.

lines.zh: 我在等一只落进水里的虫子。
lines.en: I am waiting for an insect to fall in.

lines.zh: 阳光透下来，鳞片上有一格一格的光。
lines.en: Sun filters down in squares across my scales.

lines.zh: 河底的沙纹很好看，我看久了。
lines.en: The sand ripples are pretty; I stare a while.

lines.zh: 我吐出一串小泡，看它们升。
lines.en: I blow a string of bubbles and watch them rise.

lines.zh: 月亮出来时，我会换个颜色。
lines.en: When the moon rises, my colour changes.

lines.zh: 我不动的时候，没人分得清我和石头。
lines.en: Still as I am, nobody tells me from stone.

lines.zh: 水面有涟漪，是雨点落下来。
lines.en: Ripples spread on the surface: rain is falling.

lines.zh: 我摆摆鳍，只是让水流动。
lines.en: I wave my fins just to keep water moving.

lines.zh: 你蹲在岸边，影子压在水上。
lines.en: You crouch at the bank; your shadow presses the water.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，眼睛隔着水。
lines.en: I look up at you through a layer of water.

lines.zh: 你的手伸进河里，我就退。
lines.en: Your hand enters the river, so I back away.

lines.zh: 你不像鹭，也不像熊。
lines.en: You are neither a heron nor a bear.

lines.zh: 我看了你很久，你没动。
lines.en: I watched you a long time and you stayed still.

lines.zh: 你的倒影比我大太多了。
lines.en: Your reflection is far too big for me.

lines.zh: 我从水面下打量你的靴子。
lines.en: From under the surface I study your boots.

lines.zh: 你也在看我，我们就这么对着。
lines.en: You look back, and so we keep facing each other.

lines.zh: 我浮近一点，看清你的脸。
lines.en: I float closer to get a clear look at you.

lines.zh: 你在河边站着，像一棵树。
lines.en: Standing by the river, you look like a tree.

lines.zh: 我掉了一片鳞，顺着水漂远。
lines.en: A scale came off and drifted downstream.

lines.zh: 疼，我窜到石头底下。
lines.en: It hurts, so I dart under a stone.

lines.zh: 你打中了，可水里不好使劲。
lines.en: You hit me, but water blunts the force.

lines.zh: 我的胸鳍撕开一道口。
lines.en: A slash has opened along my pectoral fin.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，像红雾。
lines.en: My blood spreads through the water like red mist.

lines.zh: 我肚皮朝上，又翻正了。
lines.en: I went belly-up, then righted myself.

lines.zh: 这一下把我拍进了沙里。
lines.en: That blow drove me into the sand.

lines.zh: 我逃得很快，尾巴还在抖。
lines.en: I flee fast, my tail still trembling.

lines.zh: 你手劲真大，我只是条小鱼。
lines.en: You swing hard, and I am only a small fish.

lines.zh: 我躲进芦苇根，先不出来了。
lines.en: I hide in the reed roots and stay there.

lines.zh: 水里有面包屑的味道。
lines.en: There is bread crumb scent in the water.

lines.zh: 那点碎屑，我绕了三圈。
lines.en: I circle that little scrap three full times.

lines.zh: 你把饵丢下来，我就忘了怕。
lines.en: You drop bait, and I forget to be afraid.

lines.zh: 我只吃小虫，不吃你的钩。
lines.en: I eat small bugs, never your hook.

lines.zh: 香味顺着水流过来，我顶不住。
lines.en: The smell drifts downstream and I cannot resist.

lines.zh: 我张嘴去咬，尾巴先颤了一下。
lines.en: I open my mouth to bite; my tail trembles first.

lines.zh: 面包在水里散开，像一朵云。
lines.en: The bread spreads in the water like a cloud.

lines.zh: 我靠近，又退开，再靠近。
lines.en: I come close, retreat, then come close again.

lines.zh: 你手里那点吃的，我认得。
lines.en: I know that little bit of food in your hand.

lines.zh: 若不是钩，我早就吃了。
lines.en: Were it not for the hook, I would have eaten.

lines.zh: 你踩进水里，撞散了河底的沙。
lines.en: You step in and scatter the sand below.

lines.zh: 我的身子被水波推开。
lines.en: The wave you make pushes my body aside.

lines.zh: 你踢到石头，我慌忙窜开。
lines.en: You kick a stone and I dart off in alarm.

lines.zh: 别用靴子搅这条浅溪。
lines.en: Do not stir this shallow creek with your boots.

lines.zh: 我一头撞在你的小腿上。
lines.en: I bump head-first into your shin.

lines.zh: 水花溅起来，我躲进芦苇。
lines.en: Water splashes up; I hide in the reeds.

lines.zh: 你挡住了水流，我绕开你。
lines.en: You block the current, so I swim around you.

lines.zh: 我被挤得贴住了河岸。
lines.en: The press of water pins me to the bank.

lines.zh: 你一动，整片浅滩都在晃。
lines.en: One move from you and the whole shallows shake.

lines.zh: 我滑过你的脚边，凉的。
lines.en: I slide past your feet, and the water is cold.

lines.zh: 春天水暖，我要找同色的伴。
lines.en: Spring water warms, and I seek a mate of my colour.

lines.zh: 那条果园色的，游得真稳。
lines.en: That orchard-coloured one swims so steadily.

lines.zh: 我们俩在水草间打转。
lines.en: The two of us turn among the water weeds.

lines.zh: 我把鳍张开，让她看我的颜色。
lines.en: I spread my fins to show her my colour.

lines.zh: 河湾里会多出一群小鱼。
lines.en: This bend will soon hold a crowd of small fry.

lines.zh: 她摆了一下尾，我就跟上。
lines.en: She flicked her tail once and I followed.

lines.zh: 我们的鳞在阳光下发亮。
lines.en: Our scales shine in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 同一种变种才认得出彼此。
lines.en: Only the same variant recognise one another.

lines.zh: 我守着这片浅滩等她。
lines.en: I keep watch over this shallow flat for her.

lines.zh: 水草间挤满了我俩的影子。
lines.en: The weeds are crowded with both our shadows.

lines.zh: 河底有块亮东西，我顶了一下。
lines.en: Something bright lies below; I nudge it with my snout.

lines.zh: 我用嘴推着它走了半尺。
lines.en: I push it along half a foot with my mouth.

lines.zh: 这枚小东西，我含着又吐了。
lines.en: This little thing: I hold it, then spit it out.

lines.zh: 它沉下来，我用鳍拨了拨。
lines.en: It sank, so I flicked it with a fin.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进石缝，用沙盖上。
lines.en: I wedge it in the gap and cover it with sand.

lines.zh: 沉在水里的东西都归我。
lines.en: Whatever sinks into this water belongs to me.

lines.zh: 我咬着它，游不快。
lines.en: Carrying it in my mouth, I cannot swim fast.

lines.zh: 这块太重，我推不动。
lines.en: This one is too heavy for me to push.

lines.zh: 我把它捞起来，又掉下去。
lines.en: I lift it, and it drops back down.

lines.zh: 河底捡到的东西，我记着位置。
lines.en: I remember where I found things on the riverbed.

lines.zh: 水面有虫子落下，我看见了。
lines.en: A bug drops onto the surface and I see it.

lines.zh: 那条小鱼闯进我的浅滩。
lines.en: That little fish has trespassed into my shallows.

lines.zh: 鹭的影子扫过水底，我立刻沉下去。
lines.en: A heron's shadow sweeps the bottom; I dive at once.

lines.zh: 水底有影子晃，我先盯住。
lines.en: A shadow stirs on the bottom; I watch it first.

lines.zh: 我锁定了那片晃动的水草。
lines.en: I lock onto that patch of swaying weeds.

lines.zh: 你的手指在水里，我盯上了。
lines.en: Your fingers are in the water, and I mark them.

lines.zh: 一只虾贴着石头爬，我跟过去。
lines.en: A shrimp creeps by the stone, so I follow.

lines.zh: 我看见波纹不对，就往那边游。
lines.en: The ripples look wrong, so I swim that way.

lines.zh: 这个目标很小，但够一顿。
lines.en: The target is small, but enough for a meal.

lines.zh: 我先看清它，再决定咬不咬。
lines.en: I see it clearly first, then decide whether to bite.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转，等它露出侧面。
lines.en: I circle it, waiting for it to expose a flank.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，贴着沙底靠近。
lines.en: I lower myself and creep along the sand.

lines.zh: 它挪一寸，我挪一寸。
lines.en: It shifts an inch, and I shift an inch.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛只盯着那片水。
lines.en: My eyes stay fixed on that patch of water.

lines.zh: 再近半尺，牙就够得着。
lines.en: Half a foot closer and my teeth reach it.

lines.zh: 我不急，水流会把它送来。
lines.en: I wait; the current will deliver it to me.

lines.zh: 我停在它下游，顺着水等。
lines.en: I hold below it and wait with the flow.

lines.zh: 它拐了个弯，我也拐过去。
lines.en: It took a turn, and I took the same one.

lines.zh: 它的每个动作我都记住。
lines.en: I memorise every motion it makes.

lines.zh: 别以为躲进石头缝就没事。
lines.en: Do not think a stone gap keeps you safe.

lines.zh: 我一甩尾，拍在它身上。
lines.en: One whip of my tail lands on its body.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，水花全散了。
lines.en: I ram it and the splash falls apart.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的鳍，不松口。
lines.en: I clamp onto its fin and do not let go.

lines.zh: 这一下很轻，可它退了。
lines.en: The blow was light, yet it retreated.

lines.zh: 我把它往石头上顶。
lines.en: I drive it against a river stone.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴比牙更管用。
lines.en: My tail does more work than my teeth.

lines.zh: 它被我撞得翻了个身。
lines.en: My hit rolls it right over.

lines.zh: 我冲上去，只留下一串泡。
lines.en: I charge and leave only a string of bubbles.

lines.zh: 水面炸开，谁也看不清谁。
lines.en: The surface bursts and neither of us can see.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，尝到鳞的味道。
lines.en: I bite once and taste scales.

lines.zh: 我从河湾的浅水里冒出来。
lines.en: I surface from the shallows of this bend.

lines.zh: 森林的溪水把我带到这里。
lines.en: The forest stream carried me to this place.

lines.zh: 这片河底安静，我留下了。
lines.en: This riverbed is quiet, so I stay.

lines.zh: 水面亮着，我选了这一天。
lines.en: The water is bright; I chose this day.

lines.zh: 我是六种颜色里的一种。
lines.en: I am one of the six colours.

lines.zh: 天亮时能看见天空，我才现身。
lines.en: Only when the sky shows at dawn do I appear.

lines.zh: 月亮升起来，我的鳞换了色。
lines.en: The moon rose and my scales changed shade.

lines.zh: 我从水草间钻出，身上还挂着露。
lines.en: I slip from the weeds still beaded with dew.

lines.zh: 溪水浅，我的影子很清楚。
lines.en: The creek is shallow and my shadow is sharp.

lines.zh: 这地方有石头有芦苇，正合适。
lines.en: Stones and reeds here; this suits me.

lines.zh: 水被烧热了，我喘不上气。
lines.en: The water is heated, and I cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 我摔在干石头上，鳞都翘起来。
lines.en: I hit dry stone and my scales flare up.

lines.zh: 我被提出水面，鳃贴在鳃盖上。
lines.en: Lifted out of the river, my gills clamp shut.

lines.zh: 爆炸把整条河掀了起来。
lines.en: The blast lifts the whole river up.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过水面，钉在我旁边。
lines.en: An arrow pierces the surface and sticks beside me.

lines.zh: 有股冷意顺着水钻进来。
lines.en: A cold feeling seeps in through the water.

lines.zh: 河里没虫子了，我饿得发晕。
lines.en: No insects left here; hunger makes me dizzy.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面上，我缩进石缝。
lines.en: Lightning hits the surface and I shrink into stone.

lines.zh: 这里连水都没有，我张着嘴。
lines.en: There is no water here; my mouth hangs open.
